about_the_game:
Play as the Renegade Angel Azrazella fighting a host of Enemies on the Wastelands and Hidden Caves of Ancient Mars, the Earthly Cities of Sodom and Gomorrah and elsewhere.

An immersive adventure where the player has to recruit a warband from the ranks of the defeated Fallen Angels, upgrade weapons, collect items and free prisoners.

The player will also control their warband, commanding them follow and go to various places and attack enemies.

Multiple weapons

Ability to fly

Keyboard only

Created by a solo Indie Developer.

Features detailed Medieval and Classical environments.

Female protagonist.

2 Tutorial levels

Separate Gladiatorial level to practice melee skills

Original Punk, Ambient and Classical soundtracks.

A story based on Sumerian Legends, The Book of Enoch and other Ancient writings.

content_descriptors.notes: There is some nudity in this game, although this is limited to NPCs. There are naked people running around and occasionally dancing. This game has health potions, and although there is killing in this game there is not any sexual assaults, or sexual violence. There is also a naked statue.

short_description: Angels of Mars is a sci-fi, medieval third person adventure game. The player gradually musters a warband and proceeds through various levels located on Ancient Mars, Earth and elsewhere, acquiring various weapons and abilities they go. Player uses fists, the Sword, the bow and magical spells.
